items.jp: 展示会を三月三日に開催します。
allowed_variants: 展覽會在三月三日舉行。
semantic_checks: The event being held is an exhibition.
The exhibition is held on March 3.
The source leaves the organizer unspoken.
The source gives a calendar date and no clock time or duration.
semantic_unknowns: Actual tokenizer or runtime contact with date-related number handling is unknown before independent adoption and measurement.
items.pair_reason: Shares the exhibition event, object, active predicate 開催します, unspoken organizer, and numeral 三 with ND-02. 三月三日 is a calendar date. The second row uses 三日間 for a duration. The Japanese forms differ in the month component and duration marker, so this is a source-near contrast, not a one-token minimal pair.

items.jp: 展示会を三日間開催します。
items.zh_hant: 舉辦為期三天的展覽會。
semantic_checks: The event being held is an exhibition.
The exhibition is held for three days.
The source states a duration, but does not say whether that duration has already elapsed.
The source leaves the organizer unspoken and gives no calendar date or clock time.
semantic_unknowns: Actual tokenizer or runtime contact with duration-related number handling is unknown before independent adoption and measurement.
items.pair_reason: Shares the exhibition event, object, active predicate 開催します, unspoken organizer, and numeral 三 with ND-01. 三日間 gives a duration of three days, without asserting that it has elapsed. The first row uses 三月三日 as a calendar date. The Japanese forms differ in the month component and duration marker, so this is a source-near contrast, not a one-token minimal pair.
